Halcyon is the streaming platform that makes it possible for anyone to watch or listen to hundreds of video classes taught by 180+ instructors across business, arts, science, food, and more.

What is included in a membership?

Every membership includes unlimited access to the full class library, downloadable class guides, and offline viewing on select plans.

Where can I watch?

Anywhere, on your phone, tablet, laptop, or television, through the Halcyon app or a supported streaming device.

Pricing & Payment

How much does Halcyon cost?

Plans start at $12.50 a month, billed annually, and include every class and live session on the platform.

How does the guarantee work?

Every new membership is covered by a 30-day money-back guarantee, no questions asked.

How do I cancel?

Cancel any time from your account settings. Your access continues through the end of the current billing period.
